I'm sure he can fix your
Butcher for you.
Well, see you later!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
F. 哈里森先生非常厲害。
我相信他能幫你修好屠夫。
好了，回頭見！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, hello?
I'm the Coordinator of
Einbroch Weapon Development.
My name is 'Lab Director'.
Do you need something?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你好？
我是艾音布羅克武器研發部門的協調員。
大家叫我“實驗室總監”。
需要什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他談談

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you see Gunslingers around,
please tell them that I have
the latest news on weapons.
If necessary, please send them
here. Heheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你在附近看到神槍手，告訴他們我這裡有最新的武器訊息。
有需要的話，就把他們帶來。嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text:
[N. A]
... Destruction... Madness...
Hmm... Attack speed over 180...

[N. A]
Ah, sorry, I'm developing some
new weapons. Please don't
disturb me.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，抱歉，我正在研發新武器。
請不要打擾我。

scripts.text: Ask about 'Butcher'.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於“屠夫”的事

scripts.text: Ask about the 'Drifter'.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於“流浪者”的事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you heard the news
shortly after the end
of the development eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是在研發剛結束後就聽到訊息的吧？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
^ff0000Butcher^000000 is the newest development
by us, the Einbroch Firearm Lab.
It is the newest type of Gatling
we have developed. While
^ff0000Drifter^000000 is a good weapon
as well, the ^ff0000Butcher^000000 definitely has
a much stronger firepower!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是我們艾音布羅克槍械實驗室最新研發的武器。
它是我們開發出的最新型加特林機槍。雖然^ff0000流浪者^000000也是一把好槍，但^ff0000屠夫^000000的火力要強得多！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Due to its strong firepower,
the Butcher was also dubbed
as the 'Murderer'.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由於火力強勁，屠夫也被人稱為“殺手”。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
However, even Gunslingers could
have troubles controlling such
a powerful weapon.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
不過，即使是神槍手，想要控制這麼強大的武器也會感到吃力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you think you can handle it?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你覺得你能駕馭它嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我不確定

scripts.text: Of course I can!!
scripts.translation: 我當然可以！！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Butcher^000000 is a weapon that you
can't handle without a strong
will. I'll see you again when
you have enough confidence to
handle this monster.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000屠夫^000000是一把沒有強大意志就無法駕馭的武器。
等你有足夠的自信能駕馭這個怪物時，我們再見面吧。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Aha, how self-confident you
are! However, I see people with
such self-confidence everywhere.
You'll need to prove it...
But how... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈，你倒是很有自信！不過，自信的人我見得多了。
你得證明給我看...可怎麼證明呢...嗯...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Hmmm......

[N. A]
Aha! I got it!
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊哈！我想到了！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Here, bring me ^ff00001000 Orc Claws^000000 and ^ff00001000 Skel Bone^000000.
If you can bring me these items,
I'll let you use the Butcher.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
給我帶來^ff00001000個獸人指甲^000000和^ff00001000根骷髏骨頭^000000。
如果你能帶來這些物品，我就讓你使用屠夫。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Easy, ain't it? Go and prove
your ability then! Heheheh...
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
很簡單吧？
那就去證明你的本事吧！嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Ah, you're here to learn about
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 eh?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
啊，你是來打聽^ff0000流浪者^000000的吧？

scripts.text:
[N. A]
The ^ff0000Drifter^000000 is one of the many
highest-classed weapons developed
by Lady Celena. It's an automatic
Gatling which boasts very high
rate of fire, which is the highest
among all Gunslinger weapons.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
^ff0000流浪者^000000是塞蕾娜女士開發的眾多最高階武器之一。
它是一把自動加特林機槍，擁有極高的射速，是所有神槍手武器中射速最高的。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Of course, you will need the Skill
to allow you to control Gatlings,
but he who contorls Gatlings well
will receive full aid from the
^ff0000Drifter^000000.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
當然，你得學會操控加特林的技能。不過，只要能熟練操控加特林，就能充分發揮^ff0000流浪者^000000的威力。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Do you want to try using the ^ff0000Drifter^000000?
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
你想試試使用^ff0000流浪者^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Um, no.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Yeah!
scripts.translation: 好啊！

scripts.text:
[N. A]
If you want to try it out
some time, come back here.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
如果你以後想試試，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
Since it's really hard to find
the materials for constructing
the ^ff0000Drifter^000000, we only make them
on requests, and we require those
who want to use the ^ff0000Drifter^000000 to bring
us the materials.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
由於很難找到製造^ff0000流浪者^000000所需的材料，我們只接受訂製；想使用^ff0000流浪者^000000的人必須自備材料。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I'll tell you the materials
needed, just bring them and
we'll construct it for you.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我會告訴你需要的材料，只要把它們帶過來，我們就為你製造。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
To make a Drifter, we need
70 Steel, 5 Eluniums, 3
Oridecons, 70 Coal, 50 Rusty
Screws, and a fee of
50,000 zeny.
Come back after you found
them all.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
製造一把流浪者需要鋼鐵70個、鋁5個、神之金屬3個、煤炭70個、生鏽的螺絲50個，另需支付50,000 Zeny。
集齊材料後再回來。

scripts.text:
[N. A]
I have news on the latest
weapons but... I guess you're
too busy to hear them.
Maybe next time I guess.
scripts.translation:
[N. A]
我這裡有最新武器的訊息，不過...看來你忙得沒空聽。
那就下次再說吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
You are overweight.
Even if I gave you the
weapon, you cannot carry it.
Please clear your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
你超重了。
就算我把武器給你，你也拿不動。
請清理一下你的物品欄。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh...... Eh?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
Hmm... Oh?
Ahh... Eh?

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... Hmm... Huh...?
May I have my Butcher back now?
scripts.translation: 現在可以把屠夫還給我了嗎？

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Uh? Oh, umm... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呃？哦，嗯... Heheh...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Th-that, huh? Eh... Heheh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那...那個，是嗎？呃... Heheh...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Ahahahah! I uh...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈哈哈！我...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
That thing! BOOM!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
那東西！轟！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Bam bam! I was gonna fire it!
Yeah!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
砰砰！ 我本來想開火的！
沒錯！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But it resisted! So I went 'BAM!' with
my hand! MUAHAHAHAH!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
可它不聽使喚！所以我就用手“BAM!”地敲了它一下！
哇哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
And it broke...... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
然後它就壞了... *嗚嗚*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I call myself 'Dr. Everything' and
I wanted to fix it myself, but I
don't seem to have the materials
to fix it... And the materials are
so rare too... *sob sob*
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我自稱“全能博士”，本想自己修好它，可我好像沒有修理用的材料...那些材料也很稀有... *嗚嗚*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Umm... I'm sorry for breaking
it but... Could you get me the
materials I need for fixing it?
Bring me those items, and I can
fix it, plus I'll modify it for
you! I promise!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嗯...把它弄壞了，我很抱歉...你能幫我找些修理材料嗎？
把材料帶來，我就能修好它，還會替你改裝！我保證！！

scripts.text:
So please bring me the materials...
*sob sob sob*
scripts.translation:
所以，請把材料帶來...
*嗚嗚*

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
I think only Lady Celena can
make those rods......
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要鋼鐵10個、鋁2個、神之金屬1個、煤炭20個...
還有屠夫專用的特殊金屬棒...
我想只有塞蕾娜女士能做這種金屬棒...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
But first, you'll need to talk
to Lady Celena's assistant, the 'Lab Director',
and ask for his help.
That kid's a bit hysterical, but
she'll be nice help if you talk
to her nicely...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
不過，你得先去找塞蕾娜女士的助手“實驗室總監”，請他幫忙。
那孩子有點歇斯底里，不過只要你好好跟他說話，他就會很樂意幫忙...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
I'm really sorry... Here, I'll
lend you my prized weapon,
'Crimson Bolt'. But make sure
you bring all those materials
to me once you find them all!
Promise me!!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
真的很抱歉...來，我把我的寶貝武器“鮮紅閃電”借給你。
找到所有材料後，務必帶回來給我！答應我！！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Talk to the 'Lab Director' for his
assistance on the Rod.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要鋼鐵10個、鋁2個、神之金屬1個、煤炭20個...
還有屠夫專用的特殊金屬棒...
去找“實驗室總監”，請他幫忙找金屬棒。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me! I'll get to the repair
right away, please hold on...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！
你為我找到了所有材料！
我馬上開始修理，請稍等...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Aha! You got all the materials
for me!
... But where's my treasured
'Crimson Bolt'!? I will not fix
your Butcher for you if you don't
bring it back to me!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
啊哈！你把材料都找齊了！
...可是我的寶貝“鮮紅閃電”呢！？
你不把它帶回來，我就不幫你修屠夫！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
The materials I need are
10 Steel, 2 Eluniums,
1 Oridecon, 20 Coal...
And a Special Metal Rod
used in the Butcher...
Good thing you found the
Special Metal Rod already.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
我需要的材料是10個鋼鐵，2個鋁，1個神之金屬，20個煤炭...還有一根屠夫用的特殊金屬棒...幸好你已經找到了那根特殊金屬棒。

scripts.text:
-You're overweight already.-
-Come back after dropping some
stuff first.-
scripts.translation:
-你已經超重了。-
-先丟下些東西再回來。-

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Whew... Finally it's fixed, thanks
to your effort. I'm very sorry
for breaking it, and thank you
for your effort. I feel guilty
for just fixing it, so I added
some extra power on it. I hope
it'll work nicely for you.
Well, enjoy it.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
呼...終於修好了，多虧了你。弄壞它，我真的很抱歉，也謝謝你付出的努力。
只把它修好還不足以彌補我的愧疚，所以我還額外增強了它的威力。希望你用著順手。
好了，好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
唉，真無聊...
不知道有沒有什麼有趣的事...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Oh well... I'll just play with my
beautiful 'Crimson Bolt'.
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
算了...我還是玩玩我漂亮的“鮮紅閃電”吧。

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Man, I'm so bored...
I wonder if there's anything
interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
唉，真無聊...
不知道有沒有什麼有趣的事...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Eh? Are you a Gunslinger?
I haven't seen that weapon
in your hand before...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
咦？你是神槍手嗎？
我以前沒見過你手裡這把武器...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
May I take a look? Please?
C'mon, let me take a look!
I'm bored out of my mind here!
Pleeeeeeeeeeeease~?
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
能讓我看看嗎？拜託了？
快點嘛，讓我看看！
我在這裡都快無聊死了！
拜託嘛~？

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 給你

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hah! You think you're the only
one with a cool weapon!? Well
I got my beautiful Crimson Bolt!
Hmph!!
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
哈！你以為只有你有很酷的武器嗎！？我也有我漂亮的鮮紅閃電！哼！！

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Heheh... This is the newest
development by Einbroch Firearms
Lab, the so-called uncontrollable
'Destroyer Butcher', eh?
Interesting... VERY interesting...
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿嘿...這是艾音布羅克槍械實驗室最新研發的武器，也就是那把傳聞中難以駕馭的“屠夫”，對吧？
有意思...非常有意思...

scripts.text:
[F. Harrison]
Hey, let me try it out for a
bit, alright? Don't worry, I
know how to handle weapons,
I won't break it!
That's that! Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[F. 哈里森]
嘿，讓我試一會兒，好嗎？別擔心，我很會用武器，不會弄壞的！
就這麼說定了，我們走吧~
